title: Stabilization of a Heterodirectional Bradytachic (1D, 2D) PDE Pair
summary: A scalar hyperbolic PDE, actuated at one boundary, is coupled with a fast PDE in two spatial dimensions: transport in the axial coordinate and in an internal coordinate, and possibly diffusion in the internal coordinate. Backstepping designs exist for coupled hyperbolic systems, for their ensembles, and for their continua, but in all of these the second variable of the fast subsystem carries no transport or diffusion; when it does, no design is available, and from a scalar input no exact control of the two-dimensional state is to be expected.
